name: Jeshaiah
overview: Jeshaiah is a male descendant of the tribe of Benjamin, as explicitly noted in Nehemiah 11:7. His identity is closely tied to his tribal heritage, emphasizing his place within the Benjaminite lineage. There are no additional notes recorded about his life or activities.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeshaiah means 'YHWH will save,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that underscores God's saving power. This proper name, recorded in Nehemiah 11:7, highlights the believer's trust in divine salvation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jeshaiah as the son of Ithiel, an inferred relationship from Nehemiah 11:7. Beyond this paternal link and his descent from Benjamin, no further family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Jeshaiah's significance lies primarily in his identification as a Benjaminite, situating him within the restored community described in Nehemiah. His mention reflects the continuity of God's covenant people through tribal lineage after the exile. While details of his personal deeds are not provided, his inclusion affirms the preservation and reestablishment of the tribes of Israel under God's providence.
